question: Rani Karnaa Nayak, who was awarded the Padma Shri in 2014, was a ______ dancer.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kathak**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• Many people consider **Rani Karnaa**, an Indian classical dancer famed for her mastery of the **Kathak **dance style, to be one of the genre's best practitioners.
 
• In **2014**, the Indian government recognised her contributions to the dance world by giving her the **Padma Shri**, the country's fourth-highest civilian honour.
 
• Rani Karnaa is credited with **fusing **the **customs **of the **Jaipur **and **Lucknow gharanas **in addition to spreading Kathak through her performances.
 
• Many commentators have praised her for her work fusing the **literature**, **music**, and **dance **of various cultural traditions with Kathak.
 
• She is credited with **fusing artistic expression **with **inventive thinking**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• Rani Karnaa was born in **Hyderabad**, in what is now modern Pakistan and former British India, in **1939 **to a Sindhi dynasty of amirs.
 
• **Assandas Karnaa**, her father, was originally from the Karnamalani family in the **Larkana district**.
 
• Over time, the family name **Karnamalani **became shortened to Karanani and then to Karnaa.
 
• When Rani was three years old, her family **relocated **to **Delhi**.
 
• Her early education was in Delhi, and she received her degree in **botany **from the **Hindu College **there.
 
• Later, she earned an **Honours degree **in **Botany**, but she chose to focus on her **dance profession **rather than her academics.
